subject: Precise meanings of contours in geom_density2d

messages.author: 15fad4275acf3998
messages.subject: Precise meanings of contours in geom_density2d
parts:
Hi all,

I have a plot of the form:

ggplot(d, aes(x=x, y=y, z=z)) + geom_density2d(h=3, bins=4)

where z is integer counts of observations.

I see four contour lines. How should I interpret these lines? Specifically I want to know what percentage of the observations are within the largest contour. Is this kind of interpretation possible?

Many thanks,
Richard
